reasoning_input.question_text: Find the Cartesian equation for the locus of z = x + iy given by |z - 3 - 4i| = 5.
reasoning_input.final_answer: Circle centered at (3, 4) with radius 5: (x - 3)² + (y - 4)² = 25 or x² + y² - 6x - 8y = 0

steps.description: Substitute z = x + iy and group real and imaginary parts
Apply modulus formula to set up square root expression
Square both sides to form circle equation (x-3)² + (y-4)² = 25
Identify center (3,4) and radius 5 / expanded Cartesian equation
